1: evaṁ satata-yuktā ye bhaktās tvāṁ paryupāsate |
ye chāpy akṣharam avyaktaṁ teṣhāṁ ke yoga-vittamāḥ ||
2: mayy āveśhya mano ye māṁ nitya-yuktā upāsate |
śhraddhayā parayopetās te me yuktatamā matāḥ ||
3: ye tv akṣharam anirdeśhyam avyaktaṁ paryupāsate |
te prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ ||
4: sanniyamyendriya-grāmaṁ  sarvatra    sama-buddhayaḥ  te  prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite    ratāḥ ||
5: avyaktā hi gatir duḥkhaṁ dehavadbhir avāpyate ||
6: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ |
7: bhavāmi na chirāt pārtha mayy āveśhita-chetasām ||
8: mayy eva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṁ niveśhaya |
nivasiṣhyasi mayy eva ata ūrdhvaṁ na sanśhayaḥ ||
9: atha chittaṁ samādhātuṁ na śhaknoṣhi mayi sthiram |
10: mad-artham api karmāṇi kurvan siddhim avāpsyasi ||
11: athaitad apy aśhakto ’si kartuṁ mad-yogam āśhritaḥ |
12: śhreyo hi jñānam abhyāsāj jñānād dhyānaṁ viśhiṣhyate |
13: adveṣhṭā sarva-bhūtānāṁ maitraḥ karuṇa eva cha |
14: mayy arpita-mano-buddhir yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ ||
15: yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate cha yaḥ |
harṣhāmarṣha-bhayodvegair mukto yaḥ sa cha me priyaḥ ||
16: sarvārambha-parityāgī yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ ||
17: yo na hṛiṣhyati na dveṣhṭi na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati |
śhubhāśhubha-parityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ sa me priyaḥ ||
18: samaḥ śhatrau cha mitre cha tathā mānāpamānayoḥ |
19: aniketaḥ sthira-matir bhaktimān me priyo naraḥ ||
20: ye tu dharmyāmṛitam idaṁ yathoktaṁ paryupāsate |
śhraddadhānā mat-paramā bhaktās te ’tīva me priyāḥ ||
